FAME II can save 5.4 mt oil: NITI Aayog report

By:The Hindu BusinessLine - 06 April,2019

Short Detail

Vehicles eligible under the Faster Adoption and Manufacturing of Electric Vehicles II (FAME II) scheme can cumulatively save 5.4 million tonnes of oil equivalent over their lifetime, worth ₹17,200 crore, a study said on Friday.

Under the Faster Adoption and Manufacturing of Electric Vehicles II (FAME II) scheme, the NITI Aayog and Rocky Mountain Institute (RMI) have released a report titled ‘India’s Electric Mobility Transformation: Progress to Date and Future Opportunities’. The report is based on opportunities for the automobile sector and government.

In February 2019, the FAME II scheme was notified by the Union Cabinet. The objective of the scheme is to enhance the government’s commitment to a clean mobility future with a major focus on electric automobiles.

India, Ukraine discuss ways to boost bilateral trade, investments

By:The Hindu BusinessLine - 03 April,2019(IST)

Short Detail

India and Ukraine have discussed bilateral trade featuring the importance of Exports and Imports between the two nations.

Indian Army Sets Record by Building Longest Bridge on Indus River in Leh Within 40 Days, Twitter Cheers

By:News18 - 03 April,2019

Short Detail

The 260 feet long cable-suspension bridge, named 'Maitri Bridge' bridge was constructed by the Indian Army in a short span of 40 days,about 500 tonnes of construction material were required for building it.

'Maitri Bridge' Source:India Today

According to the news agency, the bridge was inaugurated by war veterans who have been part of operations in 1947-48, 1962, 1971 and 1999 in Jammu and Kashmir. Naik Phunchok Angdus & Naik Shezwan Stobdan, two senior Ladakhi war veterans, were at the helm of the inauguration. The name of the bridge, "Maitri", is meant to symbolise the amity and solidarity between soldiers and locals.

By:Firstpost - 02 April,2019

Short Detail
